title: Practice 3: Perfective or imperfective? The prefixed verbs in use

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Tom brought me home.
exercises.why: **привёз** — past tense (masculine) of привезти: perfective (imperfective partner: привозить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: A wasp flew into Tom's mouth.
exercises.why: **залетела** — past tense (feminine) of залететь: perfective (imperfective partner: залетать).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: The bus arrived empty.
exercises.why: **пришел** — past tense (masculine) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Did you bring an umbrella with you?
exercises.why: **принёс** — past tense (masculine) of принести: perfective (imperfective partner: приносить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: A mouse came into the room.
exercises.why: **вбежала** — past tense (feminine) of вбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: вбегать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: After all she did not come.
exercises.why: **пришла** — past tense (feminine) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The boat was carried away with the current.
exercises.why: **снесло** — past tense (neuter) of снести: perfective (imperfective partner: сносить).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: Tom is finally back.
exercises.why: **пришел** — past tense (masculine) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: The plane still hasn't taken off.
exercises.why: **взлетел** — past tense (masculine) of взлететь: perfective (imperfective partner: взлетать).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: I was scolded by my teacher.
exercises.why: **влетело** — past tense (neuter) of влететь: perfective (imperfective partner: влетать).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: He was taken to the hospital.
exercises.why: **увезли** — past tense (plural) of увезти: perfective (imperfective partner: увозить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: After winter came spring.
exercises.why: **пришла** — past tense (feminine) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Tom flew to Australia.
exercises.why: **улетел** — past tense (masculine) of улететь: perfective (imperfective partner: улетать).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: Tom is out of the race.
exercises.why: **сошёл** — past tense (masculine) of сойти: perfective (imperfective partner: сходить).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: The house was carried away by the flood.
exercises.why: **унесло** — past tense (neuter) of унести: perfective (imperfective partner: уносить).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).

exercises.q: She ran up the stairs.
exercises.why: **взбежала** — past tense (feminine) of взбежать: perfective (imperfective partner: взбегать).  Prefix **вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос-**: movement upwards (в / на + acc).

exercises.q: The water came up to our necks.
exercises.why: **дошла** — past tense (feminine) of дойти: perfective (imperfective partner: доходить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).

exercises.q: You crossed over the road.
exercises.why: **перешли** — past tense (plural) of перейти: perfective (imperfective partner: переходить).  Prefix **пере-**: movement across, from one point to another; through (через + acc.; without preposition + acc).

exercises.q: Tom got out of the limo.
exercises.why: **вылез** — past tense (masculine) of вылезть: perfective (imperfective partner: вылезать).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).

exercises.q: The train was derailed.
exercises.why: **сошёл** — past tense (masculine) of сойти: perfective (imperfective partner: сходить).  Prefix **с-, со-**: movement downwards (с + gen.; на + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).
